text_block_list.text:
I felt bitter about my last race.
Just as I was thinking that I must seize victory this time—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Heeey. Trainy, are you super nervous?
Your face looks way too stiff."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Training, data analysis, et cetera.
We've done everything we can think of. So what's left is~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Well.
Time to show off the results of my special training♪
